items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well, I was the first one to bring Coltrane to New York.

ctx.x: Well, how do you feel about Coltrane's influence on the music?

Well, I was the first one to bring Coltrane to New York. You know, he was in Philly. Jimmy Heath had a big band over there, you know. So I went over and hired the band and brought to New York to play here at the theatre. And Trane was playing alto, so was Little Bird at the time. Trane at that time didn't impress me as being an amazing musician, but later on he did. I mean, like, when he got with Miles he started coming out of wherever he had been hiding, and really got into something as far as playing his horn…
